mapper.sql: select custom_id, type, card_num, card_type, create_time, manager_num, manager from opening_card_record
mapper.insert:
insert into opening_card_record (type, card_num, card_type, create_time, manager, identity, custom_nm, manager_num,etl_date) values
(#{record.type},#{record.cardNum},#{record.cardType},#{record.createTime},#{record.manager},#{record.identity},#{record.customNm},#{record.managerNum},#{record.etlDate})
mapper.update: update opening_card_record ocr,performance_customer_info pci set ocr.identity = pci.customer_identity where ocr.custom_nm = pci.customer_nm;
